verdict.rationale: Jan ships a local OpenAI-compatible API server powered by llama.cpp (jan-docs-6, jan-gh-4) and says users can 'switch freely between local and frontier models' (jan-docs-4). That switching claim is made about the desktop app, though. Nothing in the pack shows the server loading several models at once or swapping models without a restart. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-model loading on the API server, hot-swap or per-request model selection without restarting, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
